title: Regional tensions escalate before open war
detail: Pakistan-India strategic tensions rose through border and Kashmir-related confrontation, while East Pakistan remained geographically separated from the principal military theatre.

title: Full-scale war centered on the western front
detail: The September war was fought primarily in western sectors, reinforcing perceptions in East Pakistan that defense planning and force posture were not balanced across both wings.

title: East Pakistan insecurity enters mainstream political debate
detail: Public discussion in East Pakistan increasingly linked wartime exposure with broader constitutional grievances about representation, resource allocation, and control over strategic decisions.

title: Security imbalance strengthens autonomy politics
detail: The war experience contributed to stronger autonomy-oriented argumentation in East Pakistan, feeding into the constitutional politics that gained wider mass support from 1966 onward.
